missed.why: P2 did not consider the ADS1262/ADS1263 family. It meets every requirement on 1 placement. Source: datasheet SBAS661C (May 2021), https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/ads1262.pdf, read 2026-09-28T15:31:51Z. Inputs: 10, i.e. 5 differential pairs. AVDD 4.75 to 5.25 V. DVDD 2.7 to 5.25 V (section 7.3). Reference: differential 0.9 V to AVDD-AVSS+0.2 V, with REFP up to AVDD+0.1 V, so it takes the 5.0 V excitation ratiometrically. PGA gain up to 32, giving a full-scale range of ±VREF/32 = ±156 mV. Input range by Equation 12 at gain 32 and 10.3 mV: 0.46 to 4.29 V at AVDD 4.75 V, so a 2.5 V common mode is inside. Noise, Table 8-1, gain 32: 1200 SPS sinc3 0.148 µV RMS, 1200 SPS sinc1 0.197 µV, 2400 SPS sinc4 0.198 µV, all below 0.34 µV. First-conversion latency, Table 9-13: sinc3 at 1200 SPS 2.924 ms, so 8.8 ms per set of 3, about 114 SPS per channel. Sinc4 at 2400 SPS 2.091 ms, so 6.3 ms per set, about 159 SPS per channel. Every channel settles in 1 conversion. Chop mode doubles the latency and divides noise by 1.4. Drift: gain drift at most 4 ppm/°C and offset drift at most 100/32+50 = 53 nV/°C with chop off, so 0.01 % and 0.013 % of 10 mV over 25 K. Ambient range −40 to 125 °C. IAVDD at most 6.5 mA, below the 13.5 mA P2 budgeted for 2 AD7190. The datasheet states the ADS1262 and ADS1263 are pin and functionally compatible. JLCPCB API, read 2026-09-28T15:39:01Z: C2669963 ADS1262IPWR stock 658, presale 637, extended, 13.38 USD at 10. C122460 ADS1262IPW stock 96, presale 90. C2861295 ADS1263IPWR stock 212, presale 209, 15.58 USD at 10 (15:39:02Z). Gate is 50 for 1 placement. Digi-Key API: ADS1262IPWR Active, 2127, lead 26 weeks (15:39:30Z). ADS1263IPWR Active, 2630, lead 16 weeks (15:39:34Z). TI product page https://www.ti.com/product/ADS1262 shows ACTIVE (15:39:53Z). No driver under shared/

This is the 4-differential-input member of the AD7190/AD7192 family P2 ranked 3 and 4. It meets every requirement on 1 placement where the AD7190 and AD7192 need 2. It fails rule 4 today. Source: AD7193 Rev. E, https://www.analog.com/media/en/technical-documentation/data-sheets/AD7193.pdf, read 2026-09-28T15:33:13Z. AVDD 3 to 5.25 V. DVDD 2.7 to 5.25 V. REFIN 1 V to AVDD. Gain 128 range ±(AVDD−1.25 V)/gain, which is ±27.3 mV at 4.75 V. Buffered input AGND+0.25 V to AVDD−0.25 V. Table 7 (sinc4, chop off), FS=2: 2400 Hz, settling 1.67 ms, 230 nV RMS at gain 128. The sequencer takes tSETTLE × enabled channels, so 3 channels take 5.0 ms, 200 SPS per channel. Offset drift ±5 nV/°C at gain 32 to 128. Gain drift ±1 ppm/°C. This is the I2C (Inter-Integrated Circuit) form of the ADS1220 core that P2 ranked 5th. It passes at 3 placements, one channel each, as the ADS1220 does. It shares one 2-wire bus with 16 pin-set addresses, in place of 3 SPI chip selects, which bears on P5's GPIO budget. Source: SBAS751B, https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/ads122c04.pdf, read 2026-09-28T15:31:52Z. AVDD 2.3 to 5.5 V. DVDD 2.3 to 5.5 V. VREF 0.75 V to AVDD−AVSS, so it takes the 5.0 V excitation. Noise at gain 128: normal mode 175 SPS 0.25 µV (Table 1), turbo 180 SPS 0.22 µV (Table 5). Both tables are at AVDD 3.3 V with the 2.048 V internal reference; the 5 V ratiometric figure is not in the datasheet. JLCPCB API: C2872338 stock 4157, presale 4033, 7.10 USD at 10 (15:39:04Z), above the gate of 75 for 3 placements. Digi-Key and lifecycle not read. It costs 3.3 times the ADS1220 per part

This is the 300 mA member of the family of P2's rank 4. Its DGN pinout is identical to the TPS7B8150DGNR: 1 IN, 2 EN, 3/7 NC, 4/5/6 GND, 8 OUT. The pin tables were read in TPS7B82-Q1 SLVSDQ0K Table 4-1 (https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/tps7b82-q1.pdf, 15:37:42Z) and in TPS7B81 SBVS402 (https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/tps7b81.pdf, 15:38:47Z), so it is rank 4's pin-compatible alternate. VIN 3 to 40 V. VOUT ±1.5 % for VIN = VOUT+VDO to 40 V, IOUT 1 to 300 mA, TJ −40 to 150 °C. Dropout for the DGN package at most 350 mV at 100 mA, so ±1.5 % holds from 6.0 V. Current limit 310 to 690 mA. Thermal shutdown 175 °C typical. RθJA 63.9 °C/W for HVSSOP-8, so Tj ≈ 50 + 63.9 × (17 V × 57 mA) = 112 °C. Ground current at 57 mA not read. JLCPCB API: C424924 stock 2043, presale 2005, extended, 1.25 USD at 10 (15:39:00Z). The jlcparts copy lists this row with an empty maker under Voltage References.
